info.title: VRChat Feedback Search
info.description: OpenSearch-compatible read-only HTTP API of feedback.vrchat.com hosted at vrchat-canny.hackebein.dev.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Search, scroll, multi-search, explain, field capabilities.

post.description: Proxies to `POST /_msearch`. Body: newline-delimited JSON (header row + body row per search), per OpenSearch multi-search API.

get.description: Proxies to `GET /_msearch` if used by client.

post.description: Proxies to `POST /_search/scroll` with `scroll` and `scroll_id` in body.

delete.description: Proxies to `DELETE /_search/scroll` to release scroll contexts.

get.description: Proxies to **`GET /feedback-posts/_doc/{id}`** (same contract as OpenSearch **`GET /{index}/_doc/{id}`**). **DELETE** and other write methods are not exposed.
Proxies to **`GET /feedback-posts/_mget`** (same contract as OpenSearch **`GET /{index}/_mget`**). Optional JSON body on GET per upstream; **POST** is preferred for larger bodies.
Proxies to **`GET /_render/template`** (cluster-level in OpenSearch; host still maps to the **`feedback-posts`** dataset for search context).
Proxies to **`GET /_analyze`** (same contract as OpenSearch cluster **`GET /_analyze`**).

200.description: Hits and metadata (OpenSearch search response shape).

Search_search_query_source.name: _source

Search_search_query_source_excludes.name: _source_excludes
Search_search_query_source_excludes.description:
A comma-separated list of source fields to exclude from the response.
You can also use this parameter to exclude fields from the subset specified in `_source_includes` query parameter.
If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.

Search_search_query_source_includes.name: _source_includes
Search_search_query_source_includes.description:
A comma-separated list of source fields to include in the response.
If this parameter is specified, only these source fields are returned.
You can exclude fields from this subset using the `_source_excludes` query parameter.
If the `_source` parameter is `false`, this parameter is ignored.

Search_search_query_allow_no_indices.name: allow_no_indices
Search_search_query_allow_no_indices.description:
If `false`, the request returns an error if any wildcard expression, index alias, or `_all` value targets only missing or closed indexes.
This behavior applies even if the request targets other open indexes.
For example, a request targeting `foo*,bar*` returns an error if an index starts with `foo` but no index starts with `bar`.

Search_search_query_allow_partial_search.name: allow_partial_search_results
Search_search_query_allow_partial_search.description: If `true`, returns partial results if there are shard request timeouts or shard failures. If `false`, returns an error with no partial results.

Search_search_query_analyze_wildcard.name: analyze_wildcard
Search_search_query_analyze_wildcard.description:
If `true`, wildcard and prefix queries are analyzed.
This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.

Search_search_query_analyzer.name: analyzer
Search_search_query_analyzer.description:
Analyzer to use for the query string.
This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.

Search_search_query_batched_reduce_size.name: batched_reduce_size
Search_search_query_batched_reduce_size.description:
The number of shard results that should be reduced at once on the coordinating node.
This value should be used as a protection mechanism to reduce the memory overhead per search request if the potential number of shards in the request can be large.

Search_search_query_cancel_after_time_in.name: cancel_after_time_interval
Search_search_query_cancel_after_time_in.description:
The time after which the search request will be canceled.
Request-level parameter takes precedence over `cancel_after_time_interval` cluster setting.

Search_search_query_ccs_minimize_roundtr.name: ccs_minimize_roundtrips
Search_search_query_ccs_minimize_roundtr.description: If `true`, network round-trips between the coordinating node and the remote clusters are minimized when executing cross-cluster search (CCS) requests.

Search_search_query_default_operator.name: default_operator
Search_search_query_default_operator.description:
The default operator for query string query: AND or OR.
This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.

Search_search_query_df.name: df
Search_search_query_df.description:
Field to use as default where no field prefix is given in the query string.
This parameter can only be used when the q query string parameter is specified.

Search_search_query_docvalue_fields.name: docvalue_fields
Search_search_query_docvalue_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return as the docvalue representation for each hit.

Search_search_query_expand_wildcards.name: expand_wildcards
Search_search_query_expand_wildcards.description:
Type of index that wildcard patterns can match.
If the request can target data streams, this argument determines whether wildcard expressions match hidden data streams.
Supports comma-separated values, such as `open,hidden`.

Search_search_query_explain.name: explain
Search_search_query_explain.description: If `true`, returns detailed information about score computation as part of a hit.

Search_search_query_from.name: from
Search_search_query_from.description:
Starting document offset.
Needs to be non-negative.
By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using the `from` and `size` parameters.
To page through more hits, use the `search_after` parameter.

Search_search_query_ignore_throttled.name: ignore_throttled
Search_search_query_ignore_throttled.description: If `true`, concrete, expanded or aliased indexes will be ignored when frozen.

Search_search_query_ignore_unavailable.name: ignore_unavailable
Search_search_query_ignore_unavailable.description: If `false`, the request returns an error if it targets a missing or closed index.

Search_search_query_include_named_querie.name: include_named_queries_score
Search_search_query_include_named_querie.description: Indicates whether `hit.matched_queries` should be rendered as a map that includes the name of the matched query associated with its score (true) or as an array containing the name of the matched queries (false)

Search_search_query_lenient.name: lenient
Search_search_query_lenient.description:
If `true`, format-based query failures (such as providing text to a numeric field) in the query string will be ignored.
This parameter can only be used when the `q` query string parameter is specified.

Search_search_query_max_concurrent_shard.name: max_concurrent_shard_requests
Search_search_query_max_concurrent_shard.description:
Defines the number of concurrent shard requests per node this search executes concurrently.
This value should be used to limit the impact of the search on the cluster in order to limit the number of concurrent shard requests.

Search_search_query_phase_took.name: phase_took
Search_search_query_phase_took.description: Indicates whether to return phase-level `took` time values in the response.

Search_search_query_pre_filter_shard_siz.name: pre_filter_shard_size

Search_search_query_preference.name: preference

Search_search_query_q.name: q
Search_search_query_q.description:
Query in the Lucene query string syntax using query parameter search.
Query parameter searches do not support the full OpenSearch Query DSL but are handy for testing.

Search_search_query_request_cache.name: request_cache
Search_search_query_request_cache.description:
If `true`, the caching of search results is enabled for requests where `size` is `0`.
Defaults to index level settings.

Search_search_query_rest_total_hits_as_i.name: rest_total_hits_as_int
Search_search_query_rest_total_hits_as_i.description: Indicates whether `hits.total` should be rendered as an integer or an object in the rest search response.

Search_search_query_routing.name: routing
Search_search_query_routing.description: A custom value used to route operations to a specific shard.

Search_search_query_scroll.name: scroll
Search_search_query_scroll.description:
Period to retain the search context for scrolling. See Scroll search results.
By default, this value cannot exceed `1d` (24 hours).
You can change this limit using the `search.max_keep_alive` cluster-level setting.

Search_search_query_search_pipeline.name: search_pipeline
Search_search_query_search_pipeline.description: Customizable sequence of processing stages applied to search queries.

Search_search_query_search_type.name: search_type
Search_search_query_search_type.description: How distributed term frequencies are calculated for relevance scoring.

Search_search_query_seq_no_primary_term.name: seq_no_primary_term
Search_search_query_seq_no_primary_term.description: If `true`, returns sequence number and primary term of the last modification of each hit.

Search_search_query_size.name: size
Search_search_query_size.description:
Defines the number of hits to return.
By default, you cannot page through more than 10,000 hits using the `from` and `size` parameters.
To page through more hits, use the `search_after` parameter.

Search_search_query_stats.name: stats
Search_search_query_stats.description: Specific `tag` of the request for logging and statistical purposes.

Search_search_query_stored_fields.name: stored_fields
Search_search_query_stored_fields.description:
A comma-separated list of stored fields to return as part of a hit.
If no fields are specified, no stored fields are included in the response.
If this field is specified, the `_source` parameter defaults to `false`.
You can pass `_source: true` to return both source fields and stored fields in the search response.

Search_search_query_suggest_field.name: suggest_field
Search_search_query_suggest_field.description: Specifies which field to use for suggestions.

Search_search_query_suggest_mode.name: suggest_mode
Search_search_query_suggest_mode.description:
Specifies the suggest mode.
This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.

Search_search_query_suggest_size.name: suggest_size
Search_search_query_suggest_size.description:
Number of suggestions to return.
This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.

Search_search_query_suggest_text.name: suggest_text
Search_search_query_suggest_text.description:
The source text for which the suggestions should be returned.
This parameter can only be used when the `suggest_field` and `suggest_text` query string parameters are specified.

Search_search_query_terminate_after.name: terminate_after
Search_search_query_terminate_after.description:
Maximum number of documents to collect for each shard.
If a query reaches this limit, OpenSearch terminates the query early.
OpenSearch collects documents before sorting.
Use with caution.
OpenSearch applies this parameter to each shard handling the request.
When possible, let OpenSearch perform early termination automatically.
Avoid specifying this parameter for requests that target data streams with backing indexes across multiple data tiers.
If set to `0` (default), the query does not terminate early.

Search_search_query_timeout.name: timeout
Search_search_query_timeout.description:
Specifies the period of time to wait for a response from each shard.
If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.

Search_search_query_track_scores.name: track_scores
Search_search_query_track_scores.description: If `true`, calculate and return document scores, even if the scores are not used for sorting.

Search_search_query_track_total_hits.name: track_total_hits
Search_search_query_track_total_hits.description:
Number of hits matching the query to count accurately.
If `true`, the exact number of hits is returned at the cost of some performance.
If `false`, the response does not include the total number of hits matching the query.

Search_search_query_typed_keys.name: typed_keys
Search_search_query_typed_keys.description: If `true`, aggregation and suggester names are be prefixed by their respective types in the response.

Search_search_query_verbose_pipeline.name: verbose_pipeline
Search_search_query_verbose_pipeline.description:
Enables or disables verbose mode for the search pipeline.
When verbose mode is enabled, detailed information about each processor
in the search pipeline is included in the search response. This includes
the processor name, execution status, input, output, and time taken for processing.
This parameter is primarily intended for debugging purposes, allowing users
to track how data flows and transforms through the search pipeline.

Search_search_query_version.name: version
Search_search_query_version.description: If `true`, returns document version as part of a hit.

Search_global_query_pretty.name: pretty
Search_global_query_pretty.description: Whether to pretty-format the returned JSON response.

Search_global_query_human.name: human
Search_global_query_human.description: Whether to return human-readable values for statistics.

Search_global_query_error_trace.name: error_trace
Search_global_query_error_trace.description: Whether to include the stack trace of returned errors.

Search_global_query_source.name: source
Search_global_query_source.description: The URL-encoded request definition. Useful for libraries that do not accept a request body for non-POST requests.

Search_global_query_filter_path.name: filter_path
Search_global_query_filter_path.description: A comma-separated list of filters used to filter the response. Use wildcards to match any field or part of a field's name. To exclude fields, use `-`.
